notes: Measured on AE 2026 8 bpc, bit-exact (every pixel, Level 4 and 2): AE posterizes the STRAIGHT 8-bit colour, per channel idx = floor(c8 * Level / 256), c8' = round(idx * 255 / (Level - 1)); alpha untouched (the 50 % alpha region keeps alpha 128 and is posterized on its straight colour: premultiplied posterizing is wrong), then AE's 8-bit premultiply (c8' * a8 + 127) div 255. Not covered by a visible ref: Levels where 255/(Level-1) is not an integer (half-way values rounded half up here; AE might truncate: <= 1/255) and the band index law /256 vs /255 differs only for some Levels (e.g. 3: c = 85) — both identical at Levels 2, 4, 6. AE 2 Compositing Options (effect opacity / masks) not reproduced. Rive residuals (max 1-2/255, mean <= 0.008 %) are the Rive canvas/composite +-1 noise already documented on tint/invert, not the shader.
